title: Waivable Principal After a Monetary Redetermination Notice — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Interpretive Note
content:
For an overpayment among Benefit Overpayment Accounts caused by an employer's wage report error or by a monetary redetermination, the waivable principal stops at the claimant's notice of the claim's monetary redetermination, dated by the claim's latest monetary determination when it is a redetermination.

## Terms

- **Cause**: the cause shown on the overpayment record, either employer wage report error or monetary redetermination.
- **The notice**: the claim is the one named on the overpayment record, held among the claimant's Unemployment Benefit Claims. Its latest monetary determination is a redetermination when its determination number is 2 or more; the notice is then dated on that latest monetary determination date. When the latest determination is the original (number 1), there is no notice for this purpose.
- **The overpaid period**: overpaid weeks are recorded by the Saturdays ending them, so the overpaid period begins on the Sunday six days before the first overpaid week's ending date and ends on the last overpaid week's ending date.

## Rule

| Notice | Waivable principal |
|---|---|
| Dated within the overpaid period | Only the share of the unpaid principal belonging to the overpaid weeks ending on or before the notice, each overpaid week carrying an equal share |
| Dated before the overpaid period began | Nothing |
| Every other case | The whole unpaid principal |

The equal share is the unpaid principal multiplied by the number of overpaid weeks ending on or before the notice and divided by the number of overpaid weeks in the period.

## Hypothetical case

An overpayment for employer wage report error; overpaid weeks ending Saturday 7 February 2026 to Saturday 25 April 2026, twelve weeks; the overpaid period begins on Sunday 1 February 2026; USD 3,600.00 of principal stands unpaid; the claim's latest monetary determination is number 2.

| Latest monetary determination date | Weeks ending on or before it | Waivable principal |
|---|---|---|
| 18 March 2026 | 6 | USD 3,600.00 times 6 divided by 12, USD 1,800.00 |
| 3 February 2026 | 0 | Nothing (within the period, no week yet ended) |
| 30 January 2026 | — | Nothing (before the period began) |
| 10 May 2026 | — | USD 3,600.00 (after the period) |

Had the cause been earnings misreported, or the latest determination been number 1, the whole USD 3,600.00 would be waivable.
